title: Richard Turpin Born in Hempstead
description: Richard Turpin is born in Hempstead, Essex, the fifth of six children to John Turpin, a butcher and innkeeper.

title: Gregory Gang Established
description: Samuel Gregory forms the Gregory Gang, initially focused on deer poaching in Epping Forest.

title: Essex Gang Consolidation
description: The Gregory Gang merges with Turpin's operations to form the Essex Gang, expanding into highway robbery.

title: Turpin-King Partnership Formed
description: Turpin partners with Matthew King, the 'gentleman highwayman', expanding horse theft operations.

title: Matthew King Killed at Whitechapel
description: Matthew King is shot dead during a confrontation with authorities at Whitechapel.

title: John Palmer Alias Adopted
description: Turpin flees to Yorkshire and assumes the alias John Palmer, establishing a new identity network.

title: Arrest for Horse Theft
description: Turpin is arrested for horse theft at Beverley, leading to his identification as the notorious highwayman.

title: Trial at York Assizes
description: Turpin is tried and convicted of horse theft at York Castle Assizes.

title: Execution at York Knavesmire
description: Richard Turpin is hanged at York Knavesmire. He reportedly conducted himself with remarkable composure.

title: The Legendary Ride to York
description: Victorian folklore attributes an impossible overnight ride from London to York to Turpin and his mare Black Bess. This legend became the defining myth of Turpin's career.

title: Epping Forest Poaching Crackdown
description: Forest wardens intensify patrols following a surge in deer poaching attributed to the Gregory Gang.

title: Turpinverse Canon Published
description:
The Turpinverse open-source canon dataset is published for CRM demo and documentation use.
